verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Plausible's core value proposition as a privacy-friendly web analytics tool (no cookies, no personal data collected from end-users of tracked sites), but there is no evidence about whether the Plausible software itself (e.g., self-hosted Community Edition) sends telemetry/usage data back to the vendor or offers a way to disable such telemetry. Missing for 10: any mention of an opt-out setting, config flag, or documentation addressing self-hosted instance phone-home/telemetry behavior.
